Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Nandini Bhosale. I am a 55-year-old hardware dealer living in Coimbatore. I paid Crescent Realty Rs. 9,31,00,000 for a flat, and possession of the flat is long overdue. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 69024 62302 or email nandini.bhosale@example.com.
